description: This file defines the EntityConditionBuilder class, which extends BuilderSupport to construct complex entity conditions for the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes nested classes and methods for creating, managing, and combining entity conditions, primarily used for building query conditions dynamically.

classes.name: EntityConditionBuilder
classes.description: Main class for building entity conditions using a builder pattern, extending Groovy's BuilderSupport.

classes.name: ConditionHolder
classes.description: Inner static class implementing EntityCondition, acting as a wrapper for conditions during building process.

methods.name: createNode
methods.description: Creates a new condition node based on method name and arguments, handling different types of condition creation.

methods.name: setParent
methods.description: Associates a child condition with a parent condition, updating the parent's condition list.
